name: 239. Deferred tools get a tool search on gpt-5.4+ (deferred tool search)
description: Issue #8361: an Anthropic Messages request (Claude Code with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH) sends tools with defer_loading and its own tool_search function, and replays search turns as tool_result blocks holding tool_reference. OpenAI gpt-5.4+ rejects deferred functions unless the request carries a tool_search tool ("Deferred tools require tools.tool_search"), and Bifrost kept defer_loading without adding one. Bifrost now provisions the search: the client search function becomes a client-executed tool_search and its history replays as tool_search_call / tool_search_output; with no search tool at all it adds OpenAI's hosted tool_search. Cases pin the issue payload on the messages route (non-streaming via raw_request, streaming to message_stop), the hosted provisioning on the messages route, and the same provisioning on /v1/responses.
